title: Homun shared error catalog
description: One entry per stable error `reason` plus one generic sentence per `code`; `{param}` placeholders, mirrored by formatString on the client and format_message in the engine. Keys must match across languages and every placeholder must be provided by the matching raise (both enforced by tests). A param that names an internal label (a side, a status, an entity kind — never user input) carries a key of the `labels` section and is interpolated as `{param@label}`: both sides resolve it in the current language (formatErrorPlaceholders on the client, format_message in the engine), so internal enum values never surface in a user-facing sentence.
